name: Enosh
description: Man living at the time before the Flood

points: “And to Seth, to him also there was born a son; and he called his name Enos: then began men to call upon the name of the Lord.” Stop: then began. So what was happening before that? Evil was everywhere and Cain was running it. When evil was ruling, God sent forth Seth, then he had his son Enos. Wickedness spread so much that men stopped calling on the name of the Lord, but when Seth and Enos were born, men began to call upon the name of the Lord.

note.label: Good And Evil | Generation To Generation: From Beginning To End

points: “And begat sons and daughters”: sons and daughters after Enos.
